name: robots/karthik0497__ros2-amr-simulation
title: ros2-amr-simulation differential-drive base
intro: ros2-amr-simulation differential-drive base, adapted from karthik0497/ros2-amr-simulation. It reads `pose`, `twist`, `read_sim_clock` and `read_joint_states`; runs `publish_cmd_vel`. `publish_cmd_vel`: publish one geometry_msgs/Twist velocity setpoint to /cmd_vel for the gz-sim DiffDrive plugin. The receipt confirms only that rosbridge accepted the publication, not motion, arrival or stopping. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
